statement: A one-page website for Spark 2026, the tech fest at Northfield College of Engineering, Pune (14 to 16 February 2027), where students can see the day-by-day schedule, browse events by category, register for an event, see the sponsors, find the venue and contact the organisers on WhatsApp.
audience: College students who want to find events, register and reach the organisers, mostly on their phones.
standards: Energetic, modern look with bold colours
Works well on phones first, also fine on desktop
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file
Placeholders where photos would go, since none are supplied
rules: Use only the facts the Requester supplied; never invent rooms, prices, sponsors or contact details
Day 1 is 14 February, Day 2 is 15 February, Day 3 is 16 February 2027
Sponsors are shown as names only, no logos
Show no room or hall for events, none was supplied
done_when: The page shows the name Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, and the dates 14 to 16 February 2027

The schedule shows three days. Day 1 (14 Feb): Code Sprint 10am to 1pm, Line Follower 2pm to 5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm to 6:30pm. Day 2 (15 Feb): Bug Hunt 11am to 1pm, Poster Jam 2pm to 4pm. Day 3 (16 Feb): Drone Dash 10am to 1pm, UI Duel 2pm to 5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm to 6:30pm
Events can be browsed by category (Coding, Robotics, Design, Talks), with each of the 8 events listed under its own category
Each event shows its fee: Code Sprint Rs 100, Bug Hunt Rs 50, Line Follower Rs 150, Drone Dash Rs 200, UI Duel Rs 100, Poster Jam free, AI in Daily Life free, Startup Stories free
A registration form asks for name, email, college and an event dropdown listing all 8 events, and submitting it sends the details to spark2026@example.com
A venue section shows the address 22 University Road, Pune 411007, Northfield College of Engineering, with a link to open it in a map
A WhatsApp link opens a chat with +91 00000 33333, and the email spark2026@example.com is shown
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: See the schedule day by day
Register for an event with a form
